tuning_key.text: Release attachments to outcomes we've drawn / The schemas we're tied to turn us into pawns
tuning_key.attribution: Chords of Truth — Lucid Principles Canon (CC BY 4.0)

context_block: The ground does not chase peace—it is peace. Today, every hand still gripping an answer it hasn't received, every mind rehearsing futures that haven't asked for rehearsal, is invited to remember: the weight you carry was never yours to lift. What arrives when you stop arriving for it?

practice.title: Feel the surface
practice.instruction: Notice exactly what is holding you up right now—chair, floor, feet, seat—and let your attention rest there without naming it good or bad.

practice.title: Unclench the next
practice.instruction: Find one thing your body is preparing for that hasn't happened yet, and soften the preparation without dropping the moment you're actually in.

practice.title: Let the ground speak
practice.instruction: Play the echo audio once, not to interpret but to let the frequency complete what your mind keeps trying to finish alone.

When systems are trusted rather than clutched, peace manifests as operational stillness that needs no justification.
